_comment: Curated, hand-edited feature list rendered into README.md by scripts/src/update-readme.ts. Add new entries here as features ship. Order is preserved.

features.title: Hybrid semantic + Fuse.js search
features.detail: Server-side trigram + AI-keyword search with an offline Fuse.js fallback so workers can still look up parts when the network drops.

features.title: Browse by Category
features.detail: Three-level drill-down (category → subcategory → type) over the seeded EES taxonomy with a Search/Browse toggle on the main tab.

features.title: Browse by Aisle
features.detail: Walk the warehouse in `Aisle → Section → Shelf → Parts` order, parsed from existing bin codes (`AA-SS-SHP`). Read-only and offline-capable.

features.title: Result refinement
features.detail: Chip-based dim filters (manufacturer, amperage, etc.) plus a debounced 'Add keywords' input that narrows in-memory results without a server round-trip.

features.title: Highlighted matched keywords
features.detail: Result cards bold the tokens that caused the match so workers can see why each part was kept.

features.title: AI photo identification
features.detail: Snap a part, OpenAI vision returns candidate matches with confidence; tap to drill into details.

features.title: Spreadsheet upload with resumable progress
features.detail: Chunked batch upserts with on-device progress that survives an app restart.

features.title: Per-item keyword editor
features.detail: Manual override of AI keywords directly from a result card.

features.title: Bulk AI enrichment (SSE)
features.detail: Server-streamed progress while gpt-5-mini fills missing keywords across the catalog.

features.title: Floating Reference modal + AI chat
features.detail: Quick lookup of electrical abbreviations, vendors, synonyms, misspellings, and slang; SSE chat for free-form questions.

features.title: Elliott Electric shop tab
features.detail: In-app browser pinned to the Elliott Electric Supply storefront for ordering parts.

features.title: Password gate
features.detail: Single-password login for the warehouse-floor use case (`EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_PASSWORD`).

features.title: Dark industrial amber theme
features.detail: Tuned for warehouse lighting and gloved hands.
